description: This file contains unit tests for the BasicWorkSchedule class in the OrangeHRM Leave Service plugin. It tests methods related to retrieving work shift start/end times and shift length, involving mocking dependencies like EmployeeDao, EmployeeService, and WorkShiftService.

classes.name: BasicWorkScheduleTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the BasicWorkSchedule class, testing work shift retrieval and calculation methods.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Tests retrieving the start and end time of an employee's work shift when data is present.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftStartEndTimeEmployeeWorkShiftEmpty
methods.description: Tests retrieving default shift times when employee's work shift data is missing.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Tests calculating the length of an employee's work shift.
